description: Return a full site card for one or more frontend hostnames, process IDs, or backend IDs. Each card includes the target entity plus all directly related entities: the listeners that serve it, the backend or process it targets (for frontends), and any frontends that reference it (for processes and backends). Use this instead of get_runtime_inventory when you want the complete picture for a specific site.

ids.description:
One or more frontend hostnames, process IDs, or backend IDs to describe.
Each entry is resolved to a site card containing the target entity and
all directly related entities (listeners, backend/process, frontends).

name: get_site_summary
